handoff.purpose: Module docstring, constants, helper functions, and dataclass definitions for embedding projections.

symbols.name: _utc_now
symbols.note: Returns current UTC ISO timestamp string

symbols.name: AgentEvent
symbols.note: Dataclass for projection input; has to_dict, from_dict methods

symbols.name: EmbeddingSpec
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass for embedding coordinate system identity; has to_dict, index_id, pins_model_revision

claims.text: One index per search. search_report resolves exactly one index_id and its SQL is filtered on p.index_id = ?
claims.why: search_report not defined in this chunk; SQL not present.

claims.text: Declared identity must match the backend. _resolved_spec refuses a caller-supplied spec whose provider, model, dimension, normalization, projector version, or model revision disagrees with the request actually issued.

Dimension agreement, loudly. Vectors are validated on ingest (_validate_batch), on read (_coerce_vector(..., dimension=...)) and again at scoring time (_cosine). There is no broadcast, truncation, or zero-padding anywhere; a width mismatch surfaces as invalid_index.
claims.why: Functions _validate_batch, _coerce_vector, _cosine not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: Empirical coordinate-system identity. Each index also carries an identity anchor: one stored projection whose text is re-embedded the first time a process touches that index. If the backend no longer reproduces the stored vector within IDENTITY_DRIFT_TOLERANCE, ingest and search both refuse with model_drift instead of silently mixing two coordinate systems.
claims.why: Anchor mechanism not implemented in this chunk; IDENTITY_DRIFT_TOLERANCE present but not used.

claims.text: Journal append-only-ness, where anchored. record_journal_watermark refuses to move a watermark backwards, and refuses a changed content hash at an unchanged position.
claims.why: record_journal_watermark not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: The service endpoint is not part of the spec identity. host is a call argument, not an EmbeddingSpec field, so two different Ollama hosts serving the same tag produce the same index_id.
claims.why: host not referenced in this chunk; EmbeddingSpec does not include host.

claims.text: The identity anchor is trust-on-first-use. An index written before the anchor existed (or written by a process that only inserted duplicates) adopts an existing projection as its anchor on first touch.
claims.why: Anchor adoption logic not in this chunk.

claims.text: Anchoring is cosine-based, so it is scale-invariant.
claims.why: Cosine function not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: model_revision is caller-asserted and unverified. Nothing here resolves an Ollama digest.
claims.why: No digest resolution in this chunk.

claims.text: Staleness is opt-in and currently unanchored in production. The index can only report freshness against a journal position the caller supplies via JournalPosition. No shipped caller records watermarks yet, so real searches report freshness == 'unanchored'.
claims.why: Freshness reporting not implemented in this chunk; JournalPosition defined but not used.

claims.text: Nothing binds a stored vector to the index cryptographically. An operator or a bug that writes a row directly into event_projections with the wrong index_id is only caught if it also breaks the dimension check or corrupts the anchor row.
claims.why: event_projections table not referenced in this chunk.

claims.text: Opening a schema-v1 database performs a schema migration, but not a vector migration: the old agent_events table is renamed to legacy_agent_events_v1 and left untouched.
claims.why: No database migration code in this chunk.

claims.text: True when this spec cannot be repointed by moving a model tag.
claims.why: Property returns True if provider not in MOVABLE_TAG_PROVIDERS or if model_revision is non-empty; matches claim.

claims.text: freshness: 'fresh', 'stale', 'forked' or 'unanchored'. Defaults to 'unanchored' - freshness UNKNOWN, not freshness confirmed.

claims.why: IndexStatus.freshness has no default value shown; cannot verify it matches SearchReport.freshness default.

observations.what: Module docstring makes many claims about behavior implemented in other functions/classes not present in this chunk.
IDENTITY_DRIFT_TOLERANCE constant is defined but not used in this chunk; its usage is in later functions.
MOVABLE_TAG_PROVIDERS is defined but only used in pins_model_revision property.
EmbeddingSpec.index_id uses SHA-256 of canonical JSON of the spec dict.
AgentEvent.from_dict handles metadata that may be a JSON string.
JournalPosition.__post_init__ checks position is int and not bool.
SearchReport.freshness defaults to 'unanchored', but IndexStatus.freshness does not show a default.
